name: Klášterská Lhota (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a black band into a white upper fly part and a red lower hoist part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 21 September 2005 (decision No. 60) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
